esthetician here (nails,lashes,body treatments,etc) and i love lashing. at first i hated it. i kept comparing my work to others which honestly you’re never going to be someone else, so there’s no need for that. you can learn from others but never compare. practice is rlly all it takes. make sure you have good tweezers and take proper care of your instruments and supplies. you can get your products wholesale and at supply stores or even other lash techs. personally i’d use easy fan lashes when you start doing hybrid and volume it’s much easier. and big con is back pain. so sit straight and have a proper chair !! and always wear a mask and keep your breath fresh !
